table.retrieve:
SELECT Custname = accounts.name,
		/* saledate = max(SL.date),*/
		 saledate=max(SL.originaldate),
		 day=datepart(dy,SL.originaldate),
		 Invcode=  SL.saleinvcode , 
 		 InvValue=  Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 0) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc   +   misccharges, 0) End ,
		 salestaxamount=Round(Sum (Round (  SD.looseqty *   SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
							 +  (Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0),
		 netamount= Case when Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc   +   misccharges), 2) IS NULL Then 0  Else Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc   +   misccharges, 0) End 
						+
						Round(Sum (Round (  SD.looseqty *   SD.unitsalestax + Round ( Round (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc ) * (1 -   SD.discperc * 0.01 ), 2 ) *   SD.gstperc * 0.01 , 2 ) , 2 ) )
							 +  (Case when (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) - flatdisc), 2)) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 IS NULL Then 0  Else (Round(Sum ( (  SD.looseqty * (  SD.saleprice -   SD.itemflatdisc)) *  (1 -   SD.discperc /100) * (1 -   SL.discperc /100) ) - flatdisc ,2) ) * SL.invgstperc1 * 0.01 End ), 0),

		 count=1

    FROM saleledger SL,
		 	saledetail SD,   
         accounts  
   WHERE 
			( SL.custcode IN (:al_custcode) ) and
			( SL.originaldate between :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate) and   
			( SL.saleinvcode = SD.saleinvcode )AND
         ( SL.custcode = accounts.acccode ) 
         

GROUP BY 
	accounts.name,
	datepart(dy,SL.originaldate),
	SL.saleinvcode,
	SL.flatdisc,
	SL.misccharges,
	SL.discperc,
	SL.invgstperc1

UNION ALL
